name: Test Cookiecutter Template

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run existing tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  test-generated-project:
    name: Test generated project (${{ matrix.db }}, docker=${{ matrix.docker }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        db: ['tortoise', 'beanie']
        docker: ['true', 'false']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install cookiecutter
        run: pip install cookiecutter

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          cookiecutter . \
            --no-input \
            --extra-context db=${{ matrix.db }} \
            --extra-context docker=${{ matrix.docker }} \
            --extra-context project_name=generated_project \
            --output-dir /tmp/generated
        env:
          # Suppress cookiecutter prompts
          COOKIECUTTER_NO_INPUT: 'true'

      - name: Set project path
        id: set_path
        run: echo "PROJECT_DIR=/tmp/generated/generated_project" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Check file structure
        run: |
          cd $PROJECT_DIR
          for f in README.md pyproject.toml .gitignore; do
            if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
              echo "Missing file: $f"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Check for unreplaced template variables
        run: |
          cd $PROJECT_DIR
          if grep -R "{{cookiecutter." .; then
            echo "Unreplaced template variables found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check Python syntax
        run: |
          cd $PROJECT_DIR
          find . -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +

      - name: Install dependencies with uv
        run: |
          cd $PROJECT_DIR
          uv sync --frozen
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Basic module imports
        run: |
          cd $PROJECT_DIR
          python - <<'PY'
          import sys, importlib
          modules = ['app.main', 'app.routes', 'app.models']
          for m in modules:
              try:
                  importlib.import_module(m)
                  print(f"Imported {m}")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Failed to import {m}: {e}")
                  sys.exit(1)
          PY
